artworks.description: The image shows a man in a profile portrait from the shoulders up, facing to the right. He has a prominent nose, strong jawline, and full, wavy hair tied back at the nape of his neck. The man is wearing an outfit reminiscent of the 18th century, including a dark coat with a high collar and a visible button, and a high-collared white shirt or cravat. There is no visible jewelry or objects, and the plain background features an oval frame on a pale neutral-colored backdrop. A handwritten note below the image identifies the person as James Campbell of Baltimore.

artworks.title: Esperanza, City Tavern
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving or etching of a historical building labeled as "City Tavern." The building is depicted from a slightly elevated point of view, showing details such as the two-story structure made of brick, numerous windows, and a porch. There is a sky with clouds in the background. Close to us are steps leading up to the porch, while another building is seen in the distance to the left. A fence or enclosure is visible to the right, adding depth to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the detailed line work and architectural features.

artworks.title: Trade Card of Pierre Mourgeon
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view created in a detailed line drawing. In the center is an arched stone bridge over a body of water. Beyond the bridge, there are softly outlined distant vegetation. The image features detailed etchings for foliage, with leafy trees and plants bordering the edges. The color scheme is monochrome with dark lines against a light background.

artworks.title: Esperanza, Market
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with a marketplace setting. The horizon is low, aligning with the rooftops of the buildings. A central structure with an arched entrance and circular windows is flanked by two-story houses. The style is precise line etching with a monochromatic color palette. A street or pathway runs parallel in front of the buildings, reflecting their facades.

artworks.title: Esperanza, Courthouse
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed line drawing of a courthouse. The building is central in the composition, with a flag on the cupola. Cumulus clouds fill the sky, contrasting with the hatched sky. The horizon is low, above trees on the right and a fenced area on the left. The drawing displays architectural details using fine lines to depict textures and light. The palette is primarily black and white, creating a historic aesthetic.

artworks.title: Madonna della seggiola
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin, after Raphael
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a child in her lap. The woman is leaning forward and cradling the child gently. She has soft facial features, distinct eyes, and calm expression. Her hair is pulled back and covered with a patterned headscarf. She wears a garment with long sleeves and detailed bodice. The child is facing outward with curly hair and simple clothing. The woman wears a necklace and there is a spindle nearby. The background is minimal within a circular frame, surrounded by a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Esperanza, Church
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image features a neoclassical church building with a prominent columned portico leading to the entrance. Three smaller buildings are visible behind it, and the sky above is filled with cloud details. The artwork is rendered in black and white, emphasizing detailed linework through hatching and cross-hatching techniques. The church is framed by a decorative border.

artworks.title: Esperanza, Small Building
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image shows a two-story building in the center, viewed from a straight-on perspective. The horizon is low, and the landscape includes smaller buildings and a wooden fence. The etching technique is evident in precise, linear strokes rendering architectural features. A monochromatic palette of varying browns creates depth. Hatching and cross-hatching add texture and shadow. The scene is enclosed in a dark border.

artworks.title: View of Ticonderoga from Lake Champlain

artworks.title: Landscape with House
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with an elevated viewpoint showing elements near and far. The horizon line is in the upper part with hills or mountains in the distance. Fluffy clouds are visible near the horizon. The style seems like engraving or etching with detailed lines defining trees and buildings. Detailed foliage is on the left, a figure is walking towards a building in the center, and a house with a chimney is in the distance. The image is monochrome with shades of black and gray against a light background.

artworks.title: Ohne Titel (Anthurium) (Untitled [Anthurium])
artworks.artist: Aenne Biermann
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows several large, overlapping leaves with a single flower head on a curved stem. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and black. The flower head is in the upper right corner, while the leaves stretch diagonally across the lower half of the image, some overlapping each other against a dark background.

artworks.title: Étude de Mandiants (Study of Beggars)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Jean-Baptiste Greuze, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The etching shows the full bodies of five people, including a woman, two young children, and two infants. The woman is standing with a side profile, carrying an infant in her arms and another on her back. Her facial features are partially obscured, but she has a prominent nose and is wearing a bonnet that covers most of her hair. The two young children stand closely beside her, one boy and one girl, both with soft features and curly hair. The woman is clad in a long, flowing dress with layered fabric that appears worn and tattered, while the children wear simple garments. One child behind the woman wears a headscarf. The infant in her arms wears a simple wrap, and the other infant on her back is bundled in a striped cloth. The background of the image is plain and minimal. The etching is titled "ETUDE DE MANDIANTS" at the bottom, and appears in a sepia tone.

artworks.title: A Girl at School
artworks.artist: David Allan, after Bartolomeo Schidone
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper, laid down on mount
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl sitting down. She is facing slightly sideways with her head turned towards the viewer. She has round cheeks, wide eyes, wears a cloth cap on her head, and a long-sleeved dress with an apron. The girl holds a slate in her left hand with the letters "A B C" and some text in a foreign language. Next to her is a basket and a ball of yarn. The background is a plain wall.

artworks.title: Grand Théâtre des Arts ou Temple d'Apollon, avec une Colonne Triomphâle au milieu de la Place principale, erigée au Commerce, aux Sciences, aux Arts & aux Vertus républicaines (Grand Theater of the Arts or Temple of Apollo, with a Victory Column in the Middle of the Main Square, Erected to Commerce, the Sciences, the Arts, and Republican Virtues)
artworks.artist: François Joseph Bélanger
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing an architectural scene with people around a tall column with a statue on top. There is a grand building with classical Greek features to the right, and a horse-drawn carriage is moving across the scene. The style of the artwork features detailed architectural features and figures, with a monochromatic color palette using sepia tones. Fine details and textures are visible throughout, showcasing the artist's technique and attention to form and structure.

artworks.title: Banditti Robbing Fishermen
artworks.artist: Peter Perez Burdett, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a group of figures in an outdoor setting near a tree with a net hanging from it. The figures are interacting with each other. Some are subdued or captured under the tree, while others in the foreground are energetically postured, holding weapons, or engaging with their surroundings. One figure reaches upwards. The ground is detailed with baskets, fish, and foliage. The use of line and shading creates a sense of depth and action, capturing a moment of tension or conflict.
